schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension: central share Rs 200 (age 60-79) or Rs 500 (80+), plus state top-up
conditions_met: Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line household

documents.name: Age proof (birth certificate, school record or Aadhaar)
BPL ration card or BPL certificate

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Rural
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for construction of houses for the poor and homeless.
conditions_met: The scheme is intended for citizens below the poverty line.
check_yourself: Beneficiaries are selected from a permanent waiting list prepared by the Gram Sabha
schemes.how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are selected from a permanent waiting list prepared by the Gram Sabha

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
schemes.benefit: The scheme aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations in rural areas with a population of 500 and above (250 and above in tribal areas). Phase 3 focuses on upgrading rural roads connecting to secondary schools, health centers, and market committees.
conditions_met: Habitations with a population of 500 and above (250 and above in tribal areas) that are not connected by road.
The scheme is implemented in the state of Maharashtra.
check_yourself: Roads must be in accordance with the Road Development Plan (2001–2021) prepared by the Public Works Department.
schemes.how_to_apply: This is an infrastructure development scheme implemented by the government; there is no individual application process for citizens.
